title: IBC Tank Cover 1000 L – Stops Algae & UV
descriptionHtml:
The rainwater turns green before summer has even started

Sunlight straight into the tank makes algae grow in the water, and UV radiation makes the plastic brittle year after year. The tarp that was supposed to protect it blows off in the first autumn storm.

A cover that keeps the light out and the tank intact

Pull the cover over the tank and close the zipper – the green 210D Oxford fabric blocks the light so the algae never get started, and takes the sun instead of the plastic. The opening at the top lets you reach the lid without taking anything off, and the dimensions 120 × 100 × 116 cm fit a standard 1000-liter tank.

Features

  • The water stays clear – the fabric blocks the light that makes algae grow
  • The tank doesn't age in the sun – 210D Oxford fabric takes the UV radiation instead of the plastic
  • Lid always accessible – opening at the top, fill up without taking off the cover
  • On and off with a zipper – no fighting with a tarp and bungee cords
  • Fits the standard tank – 120 × 100 × 116 cm for a 1000-liter IBC

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
